token.title: 🔑 Token GitHub
token.intro: Ta GitHub freggyrt 60 aghin 'syn oor da enmys nagh vel cur token erbee. Ta billey fork slane costal mysh 32, myr shen ta'n nah chuairt roie tirrym. Ta token troggal y mullagh gys 5000 'syn oor.
token.step1: Foshil Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, as eisht Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner (shellooder y stoyr): dty choontey hene. Expiration (jerrey): laa erbee, cha nel feme ec y villey er red erbee foddey-veaghey.
token.step4: Faag dy chooilley chied gyn benn da. Cha nel feme ec meta-fysseree tashteyn theay er unnane jeu.
token.step5: Jean eh, as eisht copee feeuid {token}. Ta GitHub dy hoilshaghey eh un cheayrt ynrican.
token.classic: Nee token classical obbraghey myrgeddin: jean fer gyn rheynn erbee reiht. Ta rheynn follym foast lhaih fysseree theay ec y tappeid dearbit.
token.stays: Ta eh fuirraght 'sy jeeagheyder shoh fo'n eochair {key} as cha nel eh goll agh gys {host}. Cha nel eh rieau scruit ayns barr yn enmys, myr shen ta kiangley t'ou rheynn cur lesh y reayrt as cha nel eh cur lesh ny cowraghyn dearbee. Ta'n chramman fo'n vagher dy stroie eh reesht, marish y cache.
token.persistHow: Cur y token ayns coadan {env} y shirveishagh ta cummal y duillag shoh, ry-lhiattee {port}:
token.proxy: as toshee eh lesh {make}. Ta'n cummaltagh eisht screeu mir nginx ta kiangley yn kione {header} rish proxy {path}, myr shen ta'n jeeagheyder geam er e vun hene as cha nel eh rieau geddyn y token. Ta'n magher shoh goll ass as ta dy chooilley chuairtagh rheynn yn un vujed jeh 5000 'syn oor.

fork.refusedOther: Dreggyr GitHub {status} son shennaghys ny commit, myr shen cha noddagh linnaghyn banglane erbee ve tarrinit. Ta lieen ny forkyn heose slane.
